# Casa del Jaguar – Ayahuasca Iquitos

> Ayahuasca retreat centre at Calle Jaén 454, Iquitos, Peru. Not affiliated with any hotel of the same name. 7 days and 6 nights. $2,800 USD. Founded in 2008 by Dan Reynolds.

Casa del Jaguar Iquitos is in an urban area of Iquitos, Loreto, Peru. It is not a remote jungle lodge. Ceremonies take place in the centre's maloca at Calle Jaén 454. The centre picks guests up at Coronel FAP Francisco Secada Vignetta Airport (IQT). The public pages describe that ride as a few minutes. Guided Amazon excursions run on integration days.

## The offer

- Founded: 2008 by Dan Reynolds, who led the ceremonies until 2014. He died in 2021.
- Since 2014: Maestro Denis Montes leads the ceremonies together with indigenous shamans. Denis guides the whole programme. Ceremonies are in English and Denis translates.
- Duration: 7 days and 6 nights
- Price: $2,800 USD for every room
- Group size: maximum 8 guests
- Rooms: air conditioning, TV, WiFi, private bathroom, ceiling fan, two beds. No smoking in the rooms.
- Includes: meals, 4 ayahuasca ceremonies, airport transfer both ways, 2 guided Amazon excursions, yoga, meditation, Hemi-Sync (a recorded sound for quiet concentration), and the activities listed on the pricing page
- Not included: flights, visa, travel insurance
- A monthly discount code may appear on the site banner. The final price is confirmed in writing.
- Preferred dates can be requested. The team confirms availability after reading the health application. The calendar is not a live inventory.
- Application deposit: $100 USD by PayPal, refunded in full if the application is declined for safety, or if the guest withdraws before the place is confirmed

## Who guides the work

Dan Reynolds founded Casa del Jaguar in 2008 and led the ceremonies until 2014. He died in 2021. Since 2014, indigenous shamans have led the ceremonies together with Maestro Denis Montes.

Denis Montes was born in Iquitos in 1983. He is a chemical engineer and a member of the Colegio de Ingenieros del Perú (CIP 271557). His first encounter with ayahuasca was at age 16, while working as an official tour guide. He met Dan Reynolds in 2011. He has led the ceremonies since 2014.

## Safety, as stated on the site

- Adults over 18. A health application is required before a place is confirmed.
- The centre does not accept people who are pregnant or breastfeeding, or who have active antidepressants (SSRIs, MAOIs, tricyclics), antipsychotics or mood stabilizers, serious heart disease, uncontrolled high blood pressure, a history of psychosis, schizophrenia or bipolar disorder, epilepsy or other seizure disorders, or severe liver disease.
- Guests must not stop medication except with their own doctor. The published window, when a doctor approves a pause, is generally 4 to 6 weeks.
- Clinics and hospitals in Iquitos are minutes from the centre. Casa del Jaguar does not provide medical insurance. Guests are asked to bring travel insurance.
- Diet: at least two weeks. Details are on the diet page.
